Name: Natural Skin Tones
Author: acerbicon
Description:
[center]Feeling fed up with the lack of naturally toned, racially diverse skin tones? I was, and if I'm going to be playing, not just modding,
I want my character(s) [i]just[/i] so. Unfortunately, none of the skin tone mods were quite what I wanted so I went in and made my own, adding
a few different "fantasy" themed skin tones at the end as in the vanilla game. It's always good to have options, so even though this was made
for me personally, I figured I would provide it for anyone else who has tastes similar to my own.[/center]

Downloads.Description: Fixed the manifest. No changes to the mod beyond that.

Manifest.Name: Natural Skin Tones
Manifest.Description: Replaces skin colors with a more natural, racially diverse palette along with a few fantasy options.
